description: Materials: Suitable for all common building materials such as: concrete, anodised fibre cement, plasterboard, wood, sand-lime bricks, plastics. Not suitable for masonry made of polyethylene, polypropylene, Teflon, silicone and metals. Advantages of plaster bricks with primer: The high joint sound insulation of 61 dB meets the standards of modern sound insulation and ensures noise reduction. The heat protection test and proven air impermeability allow compliance with the EnEV (Energy Saving Regulation) and thus effectively contribute to reducing heat loss. The external leak test in conjunction with folding rings meets the requirements of a fountain foam. Low foam spread during curing prevents rework and ensures easy and time-saving application. Areas of application: cladding and filling window connection joints, around window sills and roller shutter boxes; brick walls, cavities, wall connections and prefabricated elements; for sealing and connecting wells, sewer shafts, house sewer systems and cisterns. Use only as directed. Carefully open the container and treat it. Ensure sufficient air exchange and extraction in the work rooms. Dusts are heavier than air and spread on the ground. Please observe the standard hygiene regulations when working. Always wear suitable protective clothing and a pair of disposable gloves. Storage: Keep container tightly closed in a cool, well-ventilated place. Further information can be found in the technical data sheet, safety data sheet and test certificates. You can see them on the manufacturer's homepage.
